string.text: Take a look. Be careful with the samples.
A former hunter settled in a workshop in Rostok. Butchers mutants and sells trophies. They say he can squeeze the last sinew out of a tushkano.
Looking for trophies? Step up. Keep your hands out of the crates and tell me what you need.
Someone else runs the Arena. I deal with what the beasts leave behind. Fangs, tails, glands. Hunters bring them in, I sort them. Samples for scientists, trophies for stalkers.
My partner said I could pull the last sinew out of any carcass. He is long gone, but the name stuck. Sinews hold everything together here, brother. Beasts and men alike.
What do you sell? What about prices?

I sell trophy parts: tails, paws, fangs, eyes and glands. Every delivery covers the full list, but rare parts come one at a time. I restock with the other traders. I also buy meat and hides at Butcher's Garbage rates, but I do not sell them.
